deviations.source_anchor: The consume-a-hex-for-amplified-chaos identity lands cleanly via on-mark-consume/consume-mark trigger-grammar + curse:amplify + NETWORK_AMPLIFIER + circle, but the full loop depends on an EXTERNAL curse-automation source (Impending Doom / hex-on-hit / Asenath's Mark) continuously re-applying the hex that Hexblast then consumes -- the apply half sits outside the kit's own skill and is captured in the economy lane rather than as a self-contained apply-consume primitive (MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 keeps the consume as the modeled step). A player keeps the 'blast the curse off for a huge hit' feel; the automated re-cursing that sustains the loop is noted, not mechanized.

The consume-the-curse-for-a-crit IS the identity

mapping.deviation_notes: The consume-a-hex-for-amplified-chaos identity lands cleanly via on-mark-consume/consume-mark trigger-grammar + curse:amplify + NETWORK_AMPLIFIER + circle, but the full loop depends on an EXTERNAL curse-automation source (Impending Doom / hex-on-hit / Asenath's Mark) continuously re-applying the hex that Hexblast then consumes -- the apply half sits outside the kit's own skill and is captured in the economy lane rather than as a self-contained apply-consume primitive (MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 keeps the consume as the modeled step). A player keeps the 'blast the curse off for a huge hit' feel; the automated re-cursing that sustains the loop is noted, not mechanized.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: CURSE-CONSUME kit. trigger_grammar is the core: proc_trigger_condition=on-mark-consume + consequence_type=consume-mark + trigger_chain_shape=consume-only -- Hexblast's defining act is CONSUMING an existing hex on the target for amplified chaos damage (the AoE spread only happens on-consume). The hex/curse maps to curse:amplify (crosswalk R-M3: the consumed hexes are damage-taken-amp curses -- Despair/Punishment class). shadow (chaos) family. Geometry circle (small on-consume AoE at target; dossier: 'small radius 3.2m at target entity'). CHAIN-DEPTH: two triggers exist (mine-detonate + hex-consume) but the IDENTITY-bearing one is the hex-consume; modeled at DEPTH-1 (the consume-mark step) -- the mine-detonate is the delivery chassis (activation-toggle), NOT a second nested trigger, so MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 is respected. NETWORK_AMPLIFIER routes the curse-amp engine (bigger curse -> bigger consume-hit); ELEMENTAL_ECHO secondary. ERRATA: era floor corrected to 3.12 at ingest (Hexblast added 3.12 Heist); verify_ledger authoritative. THE tension: the build REQUIRES a separate curse-automation source always keeping the target hexed -- a two-part apply(by-automation)/consume(by-Hexblast) loop; the apply half lives outside the skill (Impending Doom / hex-on-hit item), noted in economy.
